zh-CN.title: WeKnora 知识检索
zh-CN.description: 检索 WeKnora 知识库和所选文档，并展示来源引用。

usage.title: 选择检索范围
usage.description: 在对话中选择已授权的 WeKnora 知识库，按需缩小到具体文档。

usage.title: 提问并核对来源
usage.description: 提出与已入库资料相关的问题，查看返回片段和来源引用。

requirements: 已有完成索引的 WeKnora 知识库；管理员已配置连接、凭据、用户授权和检索工具。

en-US.title: WeKnora knowledge retrieval
en-US.description: Search WeKnora knowledge bases and selected documents with source citations.

usage.title: Select a search scope
usage.description: Choose an authorized WeKnora knowledge base in chat and narrow it to specific documents when needed.

usage.title: Ask and verify sources
usage.description: Ask a question about indexed content and inspect the retrieved excerpts and source citations.

requirements: An indexed WeKnora knowledge base is required, with an administrator-configured connection, credentials, user grants and retrieval tool.
